name: Rainbow

whyMatters.en: Ritchie Blackmore’s post–Deep Purple band. Rising (1976) with Ronnie James Dio set fantasy-lyric hard rock and neoclassical guitar; Dio later moved to Black Sabbath. Commercial Bonnet/Turner years followed until the 1984 Mk II Purple reunion paused Rainbow.
whyMatters.zh: Ritchie Blackmore 离开 Deep Purple 后的乐队。与 Ronnie James Dio 的《Rising》（1976）确立奇幻歌词 hard rock 与新古典吉他；Dio 之后加入 Black Sabbath。Bonnet/Turner 商业时期延续至 1984 年 Purple Mk II 重聚，Rainbow 暂停。

note.en: Debut single from Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow. Dio and Elf teammates Gruber, Driscoll, Soule; Blackmore later fired all but Dio before Rising.
note.zh: 出自《Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow》的首支单曲。Dio 与 Elf 队友 Gruber、Driscoll、Soule；Blackmore 在《Rising》前开除除 Dio 外全员。

note.en: From Rainbow Rising; Bain, Carey, Powell replace the Elf rhythm section. Fantasy lyric over hard-rock arrangement.
note.zh: 出自《Rainbow Rising》；Bain、Carey、Powell 替换 Elf 节奏组。奇幻歌词叠 hard-rock 编曲。

note.en: Graham Bonnet era radio rock; Blackmore’s push away from sword-and-sorcery toward commercial rock after Dio left for Black Sabbath.
note.zh: Graham Bonnet 时期电台摇滚；Dio 跳槽 Black Sabbath 后，Blackmore 推动乐队离开「剑与魔法」重心、转向商业摇滚。

interviewQuotes.text: Dio brought mythology. I brought the riffs.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ritchie Blackmore

lyricQuotes: I'm a man on the silver mountain
Look into the purple sky / Where the horses ride

shortBio.en: Blackmore after Deep Purple, 1975–. Dio years then Bonnet/Turner AOR; Dio exits to Sabbath; Mk II Purple reunion pauses the band in 1984.
shortBio.zh: Blackmore 离开 Deep Purple 之后，1975 年起。Dio 时期再到 Bonnet/Turner AOR；Dio 跳槽 Sabbath；1984 年 Purple Mk II 重聚使乐队暂停。

body.en:
In 1974–75 Deep Purple shifted style in ways Blackmore rejected. He left one of the world’s biggest touring bands and formed Rainbow with Ronnie James Dio and Elf bandmates Craig Gruber, Gary Driscoll, and Mickey Lee Soule. Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow (1975) built the reputation; Blackmore then fired everyone but Dio. Rainbow Rising (1976) used Jimmy Bain, Tony Carey, and Cozy Powell—still the Dio-era peak.

When Blackmore pushed away from sword-and-sorcery toward commercial rock, Dio left for Black Sabbath (Heaven and Hell). Graham Bonnet (ex-Marbles) sang Since You Been Gone (1979). Roger Glover (ex–Deep Purple) anchored bass. Joe Lynn Turner’s albums kept Atlantic-crossing sales against Whitesnake and Gillan’s solo band until Purple’s Mark II reunion in 1984 stalled Rainbow. A mid-1990s return with Doogie White produced Stranger in Us All (1995); Blackmore then paused Rainbow for Blackmore’s Night. Dio died in 2010, ending reunion hopes with the original singer.
body.zh:
1974–75 年 Deep Purple 的风格转变令 Blackmore 不满。他离开当时世界级巡演乐队之一，与 Ronnie James Dio 及 Elf 队友 Craig Gruber、Gary Driscoll、Mickey Lee Soule 组建 Rainbow。《Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow》（1975）打开局面后，Blackmore 开除除 Dio 外全员。《Rainbow Rising》（1976）启用 Jimmy Bain、Tony Carey、Cozy Powell——仍是 Dio 时期峰值。

当 Blackmore 推动乐队离开「剑与魔法」、转向商业摇滚时，Dio 跳槽 Black Sabbath（《Heaven and Hell》）。前 Marbles 主唱 Graham Bonnet 演唱《Since You Been Gone》（1979）。前 Deep Purple 贝斯手 Roger Glover 稳住低音。Joe Lynn Turner 时期专辑在大西洋两岸仍卖得过 Whitesnake 与 Gillan 个人乐队，直至 1984 年 Purple Mark II 重聚使 Rainbow 陷入停顿。1990 年代中期与 Doogie White 重组，发行《Stranger in Us All》（1995）；随后 Blackmore 暂停 Rainbow，专心 Blackmore’s Night。Dio 2010 年去世，与原主唱重聚的可能随之结束。

title.zh: Blackmore 离开 Purple 组建 Rainbow

body.en:
Blackmore quit Deep Purple mid-1970s after style disputes, while Purple still flew private jets and played stadiums. He recruited Elf’s Dio, Gruber, Driscoll, and Soule for the debut.

Man on the Silver Mountain sets the early sound: Dio’s mid-range, Blackmore’s ascending riff, no Hammond pad from the Purple mix.

Firing the Elf rhythm section before Rising showed how tightly he controlled the lineup.
body.zh:
Blackmore 因风格争执于 1970 年代中期离开 Deep Purple——当时 Purple 仍开私人飞机、演体育场。他招入 Elf 的 Dio、Gruber、Driscoll、Soule 录首专。

《Man on the Silver Mountain》确立早期声音：Dio 中音区、Blackmore 上行 riff、无 Purple 混音里的 Hammond 垫底。

《Rising》前开除 Elf 节奏组，显示他对阵容控制很紧。

alt.en: Ronnie James Dio and Ritchie Blackmore with Rainbow, Oslo, 27 September 1977
alt.zh: Ronnie James Dio 与 Ritchie Blackmore，Rainbow，奥斯陆，1977 年 9 月 27 日

title.en: Rising and the Dio exit to Sabbath
title.zh: Rising 与 Dio 跳槽 Sabbath

body.en:
Rainbow Rising (1976) is the classic Dio five-piece with Bain, Carey, and Powell. Stargazer and Tarot Woman define the fantasy-lyric hard-rock peak.

Blackmore wanted less sword-and-sorcery and more commercial rock; Dio left for Black Sabbath. Craig Gruber also briefly filled Sabbath bass in 1979—shared Rainbow↔Sabbath personnel.

Cozy Powell and later Bobby Rondinelli both appear in later Sabbath lineups as well.
body.zh:
《Rainbow Rising》（1976）是 Dio 五人经典编制：Bain、Carey、Powell。《Stargazer》《Tarot Woman》界定奇幻歌词 hard rock 峰值。

Blackmore 希望减少「剑与魔法」、增加商业摇滚；Dio 跳槽 Black Sabbath。Craig Gruber 1979 年也短暂补过 Sabbath 贝斯——Rainbow↔Sabbath 人员交叉。

Cozy Powell 与后来的 Bobby Rondinelli 同样出现在后期 Sabbath 阵容中。

title.en: Bonnet, Turner, and the Purple pause

body.en:
Graham Bonnet’s Since You Been Gone (1979) is the radio-rock payoff Blackmore wanted. Roger Glover (ex–Deep Purple) anchors bass through the commercial years.

Joe Lynn Turner’s albums stayed competitive with Whitesnake and Ian Gillan’s band. When Deep Purple reunited as Mark II in 1984, Rainbow stalled.

Turner later sang on Purple’s Slaves and Masters—another Purple↔Rainbow seat swap.
body.zh:
Graham Bonnet 的《Since You Been Gone》（1979）是 Blackmore 要的电台摇滚结果。前 Deep Purple 的 Roger Glover 在商业时期稳住贝斯。

Joe Lynn Turner 时期专辑仍能与 Whitesnake、Ian Gillan 乐队竞争。1984 年 Deep Purple 以 Mark II 重聚时，Rainbow 陷入停顿。

Turner 后来主唱 Purple《Slaves and Masters》——又一 Purple↔Rainbow 席位互换。

alt.zh: Ritchie Blackmore 与 Rainbow，Chateau Neuf，奥斯陆，1977

body.en:
From Rising (1976). Orchestra and hard-rock arrangement under Dio’s mythic lyric.

Often cited before “epic metal” settled as a fixed genre label.
body.zh:
出自《Rising》（1976）。管弦与 hard-rock 编曲托住 Dio 神话歌词。

常在「史诗金属」成为固定类型标签之前被引用。

note.zh: 《Ritchie Blackmore’s Rainbow》。Blackmore 很快开除除 Dio 外全员。

note.zh: 开放和弦颂歌；与 Dio 合作的 Rainbow 早期标志单曲。

note.zh: 离开 Deep Purple 后的奇幻歌词 hard rock；Dio 衔接到 Sabbath；Glover/Turner 席位连回 Purple。
